Relief Officer Not Clocked In
Cannot end shift

Your relieving officer has not clocked in yet. Please confirm your relief has arrived and ask them to clock in before you leave the site.

If your relief has not arrived, contact your manager or dispatch immediately. Do not leave the site unattended.

Reliever Check Required
Back-to-back shift detected
Coverage Confirmed

Your reliever is clocked in and on post. Confirm the in-person handoff before ending your shift - verify your relief is at their post, hand off any active incidents or notes, and only then clock out.

If anything looks wrong, cancel and contact dispatch before leaving.

Please confirm reliever coverage before clocking out.
